blurb: First Magnitude Brewing Company offers a cozy taproom with 26 taps, a sprawling oak-shaded beer garden, a covered front patio, and daily food trucks. They serve a variety of beers including flagships, seasonals, and taproom exclusives. The brewery hosts frequent live music, weekly trivia, art markets, guided bird walks, community fundraisers, and offers space for private events.
